Replying to @AZTbreak97 Here it is🤗 Pattern by CelestialCB (I couldn’t find them on TikTok so this is their Etsy shop name) Modifications I made: - R8, crochet the arms while making this round, I made 19chs instead of 18 and went into the 4th ch from the hook instead of the 3rd to make the hands - Added an extra round of sc - On the closing round, I crocheted a leg (same as arms), sl st through both sides, made the other leg on the second to last stitch to close, and finally connected the leg in the last stitch (on both sides) with a sl st #crochetersoftiktok #amigurumi #craftersoftiktok #crochet #handmade #frog #crochetideas #crochetpattern
